title: Unfair Charges and No Refund
body:
I downloaded this app and paid for just one week — that was the plan I selected. But immediately after, I was charged again for an entire month without my permission. There was no confirmation, no prompt, nothing asking if I wanted to pay more.

When I reached out to request a refund, they flat-out refused. This isn’t just disappointing — it feels dishonest. The app itself might work fine, but the payment practices are misleading and leave a very bitter taste.

Be careful before you download — you might end up paying more than you agreed to. That’s what happens when app developers purposefully bypass Apple’s in-app payment system.

title: Useful and beautiful app with few drawbacks
body:
I decided to try out Fabulous after reading through “Atomic Habits”  by James Clear, I am in general very impressed by the visuals and the feel of the app and I’m for the moment using it daily that said the UI can feel cluttered from time to time there is the upcoming routine, the plan you have for today, something motivational to read at the time of writing I have a guest pass and I’m reminded of it on the main page of the app there is also something motivational to listen to below that I have my whole routine plan for today below that a journal and below that a mood tracker all on the home page of the app so it does feel a little bit cluttered and can be confusing in the beginning for a new user especially if you come into this for the habit tracking feature. All in all, it’s a very beautiful and good app that can help you if you want to develop positive habits so I would recommend it.

P.S. I would like to extend my gratitude to Guilherme B. From the support team for helping me get a refund after I accidentally subscribed to 1:1 coaching because I didn't realize I had clicked the wrong button on the Fabulous website. For any future user, I would recommend you to carefully read through and double-check the subscription details, including the subscription model you are choosing and pricing when you’re subscribing from the Fabulous website. Thank you again to Guilherme and the Fabulous support team for their prompt and helpful assistance in resolving this issue.
